# Amazon Ads
> Amazon Ads provides advertising technology, measurement, and programmatic media buying solutions for advertisers and publishers.

Amazon Ads supports display, video, audio, retail media, and demand-side platform workflows across Amazon-owned and third-party inventory. Its resources include product overviews, learning materials, API documentation, partner information, and developer tools.

## Advertising Products
- [Amazon DSP](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-dsp): Programmatic demand-side platform for buying display, video, and audio inventory.
- [Sponsored Ads](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-ads): Self-service ad formats for promoting products and brands on Amazon.
- [Sponsored Products](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-products): Keyword and product-targeted ads that promote individual listings.
- [Sponsored Brands](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-brands): Branded ads featuring custom headlines, logos, and multiple products.
- [Sponsored Display](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sponsored-display): Display advertising solution for audiences on and off Amazon.
- [Amazon Marketing Cloud](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-marketing-cloud): Clean room analytics environment for privacy-safe measurement and insights.
- [Amazon Publisher Services](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-publisher-services): Publisher monetization tools and services for managing ad demand.

## Measurement and Analytics
- [Measurement solutions](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/measurement): Overview of attribution, incrementality, reach, and campaign performance measurement tools.
- [Amazon Attribution](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-attribution): Measurement solution for understanding non-Amazon media impact on Amazon outcomes.
- [Brand Metrics](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/brand-metrics): Brand lift and awareness measurement for upper-funnel advertising campaigns.
- [Amazon Marketing Cloud](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-marketing-cloud): Query-based analytics for campaign analysis across signals and media touchpoints.
- [Amazon Shopper Panel](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/amazon-shopper-panel): Consumer insights source that helps inform audience and market understanding.
- [Insights and planning](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/insights-and-planning): Planning and audience insight tools for campaign strategy development.

## Developers and API
- [Amazon Ads API](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us): Main developer portal for Amazon Ads APIs, onboarding, and references.
- [API Overview](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/get-started/overview): Introduction to Amazon Ads API capabilities, access model, and supported workflows.
- [Getting Started](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/get-started): Setup guidance for authentication, accounts, and first API calls.
- [API Reference](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference): Reference documentation for available Amazon Ads API resources and operations.
- [Release Notes](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/release-notes): Updates and changes affecting Amazon Ads API features and versions.
- [Policy and Compliance](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/policy): API usage policies, requirements, and compliance expectations for developers.
- [Support](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/support): Developer support resources for troubleshooting and integration assistance.

## Learning and Guides
- [Amazon Ads learning console](https://learningconsole.amazonadvertising.com/): Training hub for courses, certifications, and product education.
- [Advertising guides](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides): Practical guides covering campaign setup, optimization, and measurement topics.
- [Advertising glossary](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/advertising-glossary): Definitions of advertising terms used across Amazon Ads products and workflows.
- [Retail media guide](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/retail-media): Introductory guide to retail media concepts and strategy.
- [Programmatic advertising guide](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/programmatic-advertising): Overview of programmatic advertising concepts, buying methods, and benefits.
- [DSP guide](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/demand-side-platform): Guide to demand-side platforms and Amazon DSP use cases.
- [Sponsored ads guide](https://advertising.amazon.com/library/guides/sponsored-ads): Guide to sponsored advertising formats and campaign best practices.
